blocks.text:
Breakfast. Early pick-up at the hotel, approximately 7:20–8:20 am depending on the area, for the transfer to the national park.

On the Brazilian side, you will follow the traditional walkways for approximately 1,200 m. They offer a broad view of the complex of 275 waterfalls. Four of them are on the Brazilian side: Floriano, Deodoro, Benjamin Constant and the Devil's Throat.

At the end of the route, you can take the panoramic lift. The bus will then take you back to the hotel.
